coverageNotes: Gap list X01: 20 names checked, 19 recorded. BEST BUY IS LEFT OUT: its 2024 Bengaluru tech hub (70,000 sq ft, about 350-600 staff, entity BBY Services India LLP, operations reportedly moving to TCS under a Rs 2,000 crore deal) is real. But no source named a building, park or locality, and coordinates were not invented. TWO NAMES ARE ALREADY IN THE DATASET: 'JLR Technology & Business Services India' is the existing 'Jaguar Land Rover' (G08, Brigade Tech Gardens), and the 'ZEISS GCC' is the existing 'Zeiss' (G19, GCC at Prestige Tech Park plus Devanahalli plant).
